reviews.text: First, I followed ABK9 on Instagram and always looked forward to the demo videos with Luna. At some point I reached out to Alice because I liked her approach and started working with her to train our puppy (7months at the time). The dog and I train with Alice for half a year now as frequently as needed (every other week or once a month) and look forward to every session. Each time we leave super inspired with hands on tips which immediately improve certain behaviours and later on all notes in writing to continue our training at home.  Alice is extremely professional and will adept every session to that specific breeds‘ and its owners needs individually. Every session is balanced with work and fun. It is such a win to see your dog totally switched on and willing to work. Recently we also took part in a sniffing & agility workshop which was very well prepared and so much fun. No matter if it is your first dog or you had dogs before training with Alice is worth every minute: it helps to understand your dogs‘ needs and how to achieve a great relationship with your dog.

Alice has made a massive difference to our confidence with our sensitive and reactive Viszla. We can now walk Billy on lead close to strangers and loud noises, her recall is getting strong enough to let her off lead in public parks and we’re learning how to safely let her get out her natural prey drive in a city environment. We were very lucky to find Alice and she gives us optimism we can involve Billy in more and more aspects of daily life. Can’t recommend highly enough.

If only I could give Alice infinite starts, I would in a heartbeat!!
I came to Alice when my dog (GSD x wolf mix) was 11 months old. He was oozing out testosterone, horrifically annoying teenage boy behaviour and was fixating on every single dog we passed by in the park. Walks were almost impossible and were always on either a longline or a short lead, and it’s definitely not the life that I would have liked for either of us.
Within seeing Alice for over 4 months, now he is a lot more confident and calmer when approaching dogs, goes off the lead without me freaking out that he won’t come back and a lot more interested in listening to me rather than the distractions around us. The sessions are always fun, enjoyable and filled with enthusiasm; never a dull moment. My dog is totally obsessed with her and honestly so am I!!
Apart from truly understanding each dogs needs and the bespoke programmes Alice provides, it is important to say that she cares about each individual dog like they’re her own and about handlers like they’re her family.
She is truly a wealth of knowledge and I would without a doubt recommend her to anyone who has a dog❤️

My experience with Alice has been nothing but positive.  She is knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely caring.  She helped make toilet training seamless, puppy proof the home and work on key recalls early on.

She is punctual and well organised. Communication around scheduling is clear and reliable.

Very professional throughout. She is respectful, approachable, and takes the time to explain dog behavior psychology.
One of the things I appreciated most was her patience and genuine care for my dog. She created a calm, positive environment and never made the training feel stressful or overwhelming.

Communication has been excellent. She listens carefully to any concerns, answer questions clearly, and gives practical advice/notes in form of emails that can be used to refer back to the session.  The advice and exercises provided between sessions have been very helpful.  She gives clear guidance on what to practise at home, making it easier to reinforce training at home.

I have seen clear progress since starting training.

I would highly recommend Alice to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, professional, and caring dog trainer. The difference she has made has been fantastic, and I am grateful for her help.

I honestly can’t recommend Alice enough! ❤️ She has completely changed our life with our Italian Greyhound, Milo.

Before meeting Alice, we were struggling with so many behavioural issues, and I was starting to feel quite hopeless. From the very first session, she gave us so much confidence and showed us that things really could improve. After just a couple of sessions, we could already see such an amazing difference in Milo.

Her advice is practical, easy to follow and has made our everyday life with him so much easier and happier.

Alice is incredibly knowledgeable, patient and genuinely cares. We’re so grateful we found her she really is the best! 🐾❤️

How about this.

We are so pleased we found Alice. We spent a long time looking for an experienced trainer who genuinely cares about both the dogs and the work they do, and we feel we found the perfect trainer for us.

Alice took the time to really understand our intact male Ridgeback puppy, Ari, who was obsessed with other dogs and had to stay on lead because he would run straight to any dog he saw. After just a few sessions, we saw a huge improvement. Despite Ari having very low food drive, Alice adapted her training brilliantly.

Ari is now happily off lead, making great decisions, choosing to stay with us, and listening. We’re now working on his prey drive, and he’s already starting to listening better when he sees squirrels! We have every confidence that, just as Alice helped him become calm around other dogs, she’ll help us with this too.

We can’t thank Alice enough for her patience, knowledge, and support. We highly recommend her and look forward to our next session!

We can’t recommend Alice highly enough. Our dog is our first as adults and we started working with Alice when she was just 3 months old. From day one, Alice gave us structure and confidence when we needed it most. Under her guidance, our dog has learned reliable recall, an emergency stop at a distance, lead manners and so much more. Alice has an incredible connection with dogs; watching her work, it genuinely feels like she speaks their language. What’s been just as valuable is how she coaches us as owners, explaining the why behind everything and always on hand with practical, realistic advice between sessions. If you’re a first-time dog owner (or just want a genuinely brilliant trainer), Alice is the one. Five stars doesn’t feel like enough.

We have been working with Alice to help raise our Cocker Spaniel puppy Louis into a well-behaved and happy dog and we couldn't be happier with the experience as Alice is absolutely wonderful to work with.

We really appreciate how she tailors our sessions to Louis' individual needs and focuses on the areas where we need the most support, adapting our sessions as he grows and develops. Along the way, she also taught us how to be better, more confident dog owners.

She is very knowledgeable, and her positive training methods have working brilliantly for our puppy, even through his challenging teenage phase. We're not even halfway through our sessions yet, but Louis has already made amazing progress and we're excited to see how much more he will learn the coming weeks.

10/10 recommend Alice to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, effective and supportive dog trainer!

We’ve had the most brilliant experience with Alice. Only two sessions down and we already feel so much more confident with our 8 month old retriever. Each session has been extremely productive and enjoyable at the same time, with super clear notes afterwards to help guide us in between sessions. Alice came highly recommended and is absolutely worth every penny! Ralph’s already looking forward to his next session!

Training the owner as well as the dog
Detailed & clear instructions after each session re next steps
Sessions are fun and highlight of the week for a strong charactered terrier

Both dog & owner in a much better place
Out of 10 - 15 truly excellent

Alice is the most fantastic dog trainer. She is such a warm, thoughtful and kind person and has this amazing intuitive ability to understand exactly why my doggies behave in the way do and how to change their behaviour. I had two very anxious, reactive dogs and she put a gentle, manageable plan in place for us. She has also given me the confidence to put her suggestions in practise on my dog walks. She always sends an email after each dog training to recap what we have done which has been incredibly helpful. The difference in my dogs is truly wonderful!

Alice is truly the best!  Her knowledge on canines and use of positive reinforcement for training have made such a difference for my wife and I and our dog.  She is a patient, warm and personable individual with incredibly effective techniques!!  Whether working with her in person or over zoom, we couldn’t recommend her more highly!

Alice is an amazing trainer who helped me channel the energy of my very excitable and independent standard schnauzer into the right direction. Her advice and support has been invaluable and I continue to work with her to strengthen the relationship my dog and I have. I highly recommend Alice!

I cannot recommend Alice highly enough! We brought our re-homed lurcher, Socks, to her because of Socks' high prey drive. We live in an area with lots of small, fast moving furry and feathery creatures which naturally Socks loves to chase.  While we didn't want to entirely remove the pure joy of that for Socks, we'd had multiple 'incidents' which were stressful and potentially dangerous (e.g. near roads, on private land etc.).  Alice totally understood that nuance and even though I'd seen Alice's prey drive posts with her own dogs, I wasn't confident it could work with an 8 year old lurcher.  A woman in the park even told us we were wasting our time.  How wrong we were.  Alice has taught us an emergency recall that genuinely works and we can now confidently call Socks off prey in mid-chase.  This has been a huge relief, has saved us from many stressful situations and is actually fun for both us and Socks to do.  Alice is professional, incredibly hard working, deeply knowledgeable, and highly experienced. Her sessions are always fun, and she is exceptionally insightful. Socks loves her.  Beyond the recall, she has helped us work on several other really helpful skills that have improved our daily life. If you are looking for a trainer who truly understands dog behaviour, Alice is excellent and we can't thank her enough!

Would highly recommend Alice and AB K9 to anyone who needs some help with their dog!

We initially contacted Alice for help with our little mini dachshund’s leash reactivity, but after a few sessions with Alice we figured out that what our dog actually needs more time in the park and outlet for her energy (where there were other challenges we worked on too!). After just three session our dog is already much better, walks much better on the lead and is less reactive around other dogs, and we’ve gotten lots exercises for keeping her engaged with us in the park without running off chasing runners and squirrels!

We really like how Alice practices positive reinforcement, and makes sure you as the owner understands how to implement the tools/exercises in real life - so it’s a long-term solution! In the first session she also properly ”analyses” your dog and comes up with a tailored plan for their personality.

Even though our dog has already improved a lot we plan to see Alice again after the summer, for continuous improvement!

Before we found Alice we started to think our 2 year old staffy Orla would never be an off lead dog, that she’d just run up to everyone and every dog, but after a few months with Alice we’re walking around big London parks off lead! She knows exactly how to channel the dog’s energy to work with us not against us and build a solid recall. She’s helped us understand Orla better so we’re much more confident and are enjoying our walks so much more. I would recommend Alice to anyone with a dog!! Our sessions are great fun, we learn so much and are always looking forward to the next one

Alice has now trained two of our whippets. Our puppy, Yuki, has exceptional recall thanks to Alice! And 4 years later, Alice is — without question — our older whippet, Alaska’s favorite human (Alaska literally howls when she picks up Alice’s scent in the park / neighbourhood). Alaska continues to have excellent perimeter off lead & strong communication skills all these years later. Alice is an animal whisperer, she is super intelligent and breaks down new concerns / behaviours to address the root cause (instead of defaulting to generic methods). We can’t recommend her enough!

Alice has been an amazing trainer for our Archie. She is professional, knowledgeable, and truly understands dogs and their individual needs. She always puts the dogs’ wellbeing first, which is something I value the most.

The training has really helped Archie, especially with his off-lead recall. Her guidance has given us more confidence and made our walks far more enjoyable. We will continue to train with Alice and would highly recommend her to anyone looking for a dog behaviourist/trainer.

Working with Alice has genuinely changed our lives. From being told our dog was an 'extreme case' that would never walk nicely on the lead by another trainer, to being able to confidently walk her and finally start enjoying taking her out in just a few months thanks to Alice, has been amazing. The best thing about working with Alice is that she takes the time to understand what motivates your dog and creates a realistic plan where you see actual progress. Her experience of handling all sorts of issues is evident in the way she adapts her techniques and methods to your dog. We also feel we have genuine support in between sessions when needed. We just wish we found her sooner!

I can’t recommend Alice highly enough - if you are taking on a puppy, make sure you contact her. From the moment of the first consultation, we felt in very safe hands - Alice provided practical and logical advice for handling our new puppy and we couldn’t be happier. Each stage of our pup’s growth has brought on new behaviours and characteristics that we would have had no idea how to handle without Alice’s sound advice - and there hasn’t been a thing she hasn’t been able to handle and show us how to manage. I feel like we are setting up our puppy for success - confident that we can take her with us wherever we go and knowing that we can have lots of fun with her too. Managing a new puppy can be hard - but Alice makes it feel so much easier - she’s worth every penny.

It is difficult to find the words to thank Alice.

I’m still finding it hard to believe that Moose navigated Hyde Park last week off the lead, something I never thought possible, and that is all down to Alice.

It has been quite a journey but through all the different stages of our time together - and there have been many - and often stressful - I have been deeply, deeply touched by Alice’s dedication to Moose.

What superficially translates as “she just gets him” is much more complicated than that.

A dog who was meant to be picking up grouse on a Scottish moor was brought into central London, quintessentially nervous and super sensitive. A dog who couldn’t manage himself around people and other dogs, and an owner who didn’t understand him, was being asked to just get on with it. He was lost.

Alice understood all that, no beatings, no shouting, she has shown him bucketfuls of kindness and love, she has been our translator, and I cannot thank her enough.

Her dedication and devotion to him and her perseverance (with me) are all remarkable. She has allowed us to build up a relationship over time which has created a dog who can now cope. It’s truly hard to believe we have got this far, which is all thanks to Alice.

Whilst he will always be complicated and sensitive he is so much happier and of course manageable, and he and I owe all that to Alice.

Thank you is not really enough.

Cannot recommend Alice enough. We got our Bedlington Whippet Phife when he was 4 months old, he was a singleton puppy (the only pup in the litter) so he arrived with us with zero training and absolutely no socialisation. He was very excitable, obsessed with dogs and could not regulate his emotions properly around other dogs and he had no recall. For that reason we were unable to ever let him off the lead. So when he was 6 months old, we started working with Alice.

Alice has been incredible and really understands both ours and Phifes needs and has worked with us over the months to customise training plans that work.

Phife is now 16 months and has come such a long way. He’s still has his quirks, but given his personality type he probably always will. However, we are able to go on long off lead walks with Phife, knowing he would play nicely with dogs and respond to our emergency recall without fail.

Alice is the best! Honestly!
So professional, so thorough and the dogs just love her. I’ve made amazing progress with my Weimaraner and he’s turned out to be the most incredible dog. Can’t recommend Alice enough!!

Alice has been great with my Samoyed. When he started he was very reactive and would pull me across the floor to get to other dogs. In only a few months he’s become  comfortable off lead with reliable recall. Def recommend training sessions with Alice!

AB K9 is just what we needed. We tried 2 other trainers before Alice and never got anywhere close to where Blu is now. As a first time dog owner I was nervous and Alice really helped me get in the right head space to work with Blu. She is completely off lead now and we both enjoy our walks much more! No more anxiety or being worried about other dogs. Just amazing the progress with only 5 training classes. I highly recommend AB K9!!

Dog training is such a personal journey because our pets are truly part of the family. We all want our dogs to fit comfortably into everyday life, guided by someone who genuinely understands them. Alice is the only trainer I’ve worked with who truly understood what my dog needed and how to approach him with kindness and patience.
Her knowledge of different breeds and what motivates them is incredible. She didn’t just train my dog, she helped me grow into a more confident and capable owner. Instead of dreading interactions or walks, I now approach them with confidence and positivity.
I honestly couldn’t recommend Alice highly enough. You and your dog would be very lucky to work with her

Alice had helped enormously with our young GSD, Kaia, who she’s been training since she was a puppy. Alice makes the training fun, and Kaia has excellent recall and is very good on the lead. Alice clearly has a deep understanding of dogs and an amazing ability to teach us how to  communicate with Kaia. She has provided us with the tools that we need to keep Kaia engaged with us even with distractions all around. Thank you Alice!

We're so lucky to work with Alice!
Misha - my English Show Cocker Spaniel and I have been working with Alice for nearly 7 months now. We started when Misha was about 3 months;  he's now 10 months old.
Misha is a very playful, exuberant and incredibly energetic cocker spaniel. He loves the outdoors, nature, and is incredibly curious about everyone and everything. So its been vital to train him for obedience, recall, stopping when needed, walking off a lead, and listening to cues for his behaviour when amongst other dogs / animals, and people.
When we first started, my priority was to ensure that Misha was a very well behaved dog, who could be taken to cafes, public spaces, and outings and who wouldn't be unruly or jumping on people or other dogs.
Alice has been invaluable in that training. We absolutely wouldn't be where we are with Misha's good manners and listening abilities, had it not been for Alice.
Aside from the fact that he absolutely adores Alice, and training with her, the care and love that she has shown Misha while training him has been wonderful, and I am very grateful for her kindness that she's shown him / me when we're training with her (not to mention her patience with me when I forget the cues!!) Her gentle but firm manner is something even I have learnt, so when Misha is with me, listens and follows through on commands that I give him.
I also love that after we've had a training session, Alice sends through training notes to re-affirm and remind me on what I need to work on with Misha during the weeks following.
I think if you have a young dog or a puppy, and need them to be trained and well mannered, the best thing you could do for your dog, and your family life, is have Alice train them.
We are super lucky that she fit us in, and we're very grateful!
Thank you Alice !!! xoxox

Alice is absolutely the trainer you need for your dog, especially if you have a reactive dog and are at a loss at what to do! Before we started with Alice, our dog Rocky was reactive to seeing dogs even from a far away distance and we felt like we couldn't go anywhere. Alice creates clear step by step exercises that help build up your dog's skill set in order to get to place where you want them to be. She also adapts the exercises based on how well your dog takes them on and adjusts the training accordingly. Everything during the training sessions, no matter how big and small, comes into play in your dog's training and it becomes so clear when put into action. Rocky has near perfect recall now and has come leaps and bounds in terms of his reactivity, all thanks to Alice. With Rocky's training, we feel like we've been able to bond with him so much better now! We wish we had started with Alice earlier but we're so grateful she's become such an integral part of our lives. We absolutely love Alice and she's the best.

Alice has been training our puppy since the first day we brought her home, and we honestly couldn’t have asked for a better start. She is incredibly knowledgeable, with a great sense of humour, and she explains the psychology behind a puppy’s behaviour in a way that is clear, practical, and easy to understand.

We’ve worked with her in a variety of real-world settings — at home, in the park, in cafés, and on everyday pavement walks — which has made her training incredibly practical and effective.

Thanks to Alice, we don’t just follow instructions — we genuinely understand how our puppy is thinking and why she behaves the way she does. That insight has helped us provide the best possible experience for our puppy and has made the whole journey of puppy ownership enjoyable, calm, and confidence-building.

We’re extremely grateful for her guidance and would wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone looking for a thoughtful, effective, and supportive dog trainer.

Alice Berwick, founder of AB K9 training is the puppy/dog training by excellence. She is more than a dog trainer, she is a dog whisperer.  She is training my Labrador Retriever puppy, Othello, who is now 14 months old.  She adapted a bespoke programme in detail for Othello who took to her and her training like wild fire.  Alice connected with Othello, and all the dogs I have seen her interact with, because she has learned through her long experience with a pack of 17 dogs as well as her training of both horses and dogs. She speaks the animal language of the animal she interacts with.  A great part of it is a gift, another part is her love of dogs which all dogs respond to because she also commands an authority, another part, which mixed with her empathy for these animals,  who are utterly dependant on humans, creates an ideal learning and bonding environment.  She has enriched my world by allowing my relationship with Othello be a tight knit bond based in obedience and compassion.  Thank you, Alice! You are an exceptional human being!

Alice has honestly changed our lives!! We came to her with our 10 month old working golden retriever - who had 0 recall & no interest in us when out in the park, which meant she couldn’t be off the lead. Walking her was no fun at all!! After working with Alice for a couple of months, she’s just turned 1 and an entirely different dog - near 100% recall (even away from her favourite things!) and has learnt so many other activities/tricks (e.g., search for keys, sit and stop when she’s ahead of us, spin, touch, middle, the list goes on). We are so beyond grateful to Alice for all her incredible expertise and guidance, I honestly don’t know where we’d be without her! We can’t wait to see the continued progress Winnie makes!

Alice has been working with Ava since she was a tiny puppy, and we couldn’t have asked for a better trainer to guide her through all those important early stages. Ava is a super friendly whippet who absolutely loves to play and run — sometimes a little too enthusiastically for other dogs!

Alice immediately understood her playful nature and created a training plan that helped Ava learn how to read social cues, play appropriately, and stay focused even when she’s excited. Because Ava loves to chase, we’ve also worked on recall and control during those high-energy moments — and the improvement has been incredible!

Alice’s positive reinforcement approach has made training such a joyful experience for Ava and honestly for all the family. Ava always looked forward to her sessions, came home happy and relaxed, and continued to grow in confidence every week. Alice is professional, supportive and always available to answer questions or guide us between sessions.

We are so grateful for everything Alice has helped Ava achieve so far. We would recommend her to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, kind, and truly dedicated dog trainer. Ava absolutely loves her! 🐾

Our dog Luna was an extremely friendly dog and was constantly looking for attention from everyone. We’ve tried multiple trainers and different approaches without success until we found Alice. Since the first session, we felt Alice was the perfect fit for Luna and for us. Alice quickly understood Luna’s needs and developed a personalized plan for Luna to be successful. Luna has impressively improved her behavior walking on lead, off the lead, listens to our commands including recall, emergency recall, walking at our side through picnics, while remaining friendly with others including dogs. We really appreciated Alice’s approach with Luna based on positive reinforcement and took advantage of Luna’s high capability to learn new tricks while playing. Alice is very professional, provides detailed notes after each session, and is always available for any questions we had between sessions. Alice’s flexibility allowed us to add training towards walking along the pram as we welcomed our first child. Luna LOVES Alice and we couldn’t be happier with her. We would definitely recommend Alice to anyone that is looking for a dog trainer.

My high energy dog had a real problem with recall, especially around balls in the park. After just a few sessions with Alice he is coming on SO well. We were even recently told (after calling him off a ball) “that is some impressive recall!!”. I have never burst with pride more 😊. Thank you so much Alice, we would never be here without you! Would highly recommend - she has truly changed our walks from a daily stress to a fun and mutual playtime

Everyone told me, don’t get a dachshund. They are stubborn, don’t listen and tend to bark. Well… all those things are true. However, thanks to Alice, we have a dream dog!
Our sessions with her does not only teach us obedience, manners and how to deal with reactiveness. But it’s also really lovely to give our dog an hour that is dedicated to them. She clearly really enjoys her training and we enjoy it too!
I couldn’t recommend Alice more!

Alice has been working with our dog for the last year since she was a puppy and she has honestly been amazing. We have a dachshund and I was so worried that she would be neurotic but Alice is a dog whisperer and helped us raise the most wonderful dog. Alice always makes training sessions such fun and she has managed to train our dog Moussie so quickly and easily. I could not recommend Alice more!

We arrived in London 5 months ago with our 3 year old retriever Oliver .His  behaviour was entirely unsuitable for London life .The change since  working with Alice has been dramatic . Alice is an expert in dog behaviour  , kind , caring and a joy to work with . Working with Alice has enhanced our lives and Olivers. If you are looking for help with your dog look no further than AB K9 training .

Alice is absolutely amazing! She has been with us since our puppy was just 2 months old, and she has guided us through every little step with so much care and expertise. Thanks to her, Rupert has learned incredibly fast and picked up so many important skills already. We honestly couldn’t be happier with the progress. Most importantly, Rupert absolutely adores her — and that says it all! Highly recommend Alice to anyone looking for the best support with their pup.
Alice is the most inspiring and brilliant dog trainer one can wish for. She is kind, knowledgeable and her services are worth every single penny. Would give 10 starts if that was an option.

We’ve been working with Alice since our dog Nessa was a tiny puppy and I’m not sure how we could’ve managed raising her without the help of Alice! She’s taught us / Nessa very important skills such as perfect recall, and she’s been with us to help once we were struggling with some issues, and have seen real improvements after implementing her guidance. Highly recommend!
Highly recommend. AB K9 training is a game changer. Alice is the real deal. You will get results from the first lesson. Your dog will love every minute. The best bonding experience.

I couldn't recommend Alice at AB K9 Training more! We contacted her because our whippet was overly excitable around other dogs. In the park, Kiwi would be at the end of her long line, lunging, getting frustrated, and unable to listen to us. In fact, we avoided parks altogether for *seven months* before we started working with Alice.

Over the last few months of training with Alice, Kiwi has made incredible progress — far beyond what we dared to imagine, and in such a short time! She is now calm and neutral around other dogs, responds well to cues, and, most importantly, is loving life in the park again. Alice is kind, caring, and patient, and it’s clear she truly loves what she does. Each session is not only effective but also fun and thoughtfully tailored to Kiwi's specific needs. Alice’s extensive knowledge and her ability to explain the 'why' behind behaviours have been so helpful in understanding Kiwi and how she reacts to the world.

We genuinely look forward to every session with Alice, just saying her name will have our lazy whippet shooting out of bed at 7am. Not only have we seen a dramatic change in Kiwi, but she has also given me the confidence to handle any situation and take Kiwi anywhere.

If you're struggling with any behavioural issues or just want to strengthen your bond with your dog, Alice is absolutely the person to help. Thank you so much Alice, for transforming our lives. Truly!
